ICE detains father and daughter at Seattle airport; witness describes scene

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents detained a father and daughter at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. A lawyer stated they were traveling to a family baptism. A witness described the scene as looking like a kidnapping, and another report quoted the Washington governor calling ICE 'out of control' following the arrests. One outlet reported a state official comparing the event to incidents in Minnesota.
